description: What in the fleet needs a person now, ranked most urgent first (the portal's "Needs your attention" card): proposals waiting for this user's approval, an app version failing to install on devices (last 7 days, not reported installed since), a policy's devices with no contact for 7+ days, a policy's online devices still on an older version of it, and the security grade's top policy finding. Computed by Nomid from stored data: repeat the numbers as given. With itemId: that item and up to 50 of its devices. Use it for "what needs my attention", "anything wrong with my fleet", a morning check, or a message tagged [attention:<id>]. Each item has a suggestedAction; any change is only a proposal a person approves.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

itemId.description: An item's id (from a previous call, or the [attention:<id>] tag of the user's message) for that item alone with its devices. Omit for every item.

name: get_attention_items
title: Get what needs attention
